verdict.rationale: Airwallex's Spend AI documents receipt capture and matching to card transactions, checks for required receipt details, always-on audit checks against spend rules, and early duplicate detection. Category and memo suggestion is only implied by AI filling 'accounting fields' on bills, not expenses, and fraud detection is never mentioned. All evidence is vendor marketing. missing for 10: explicit AI category/memo suggestions for expenses, fraud detection, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, AI codes and audits expenses for me — reading receipts, suggesting categories and memos, and catching duplicates or fraud

citations.quote: AI captures receipts and matches them to the right card transactions without manual input from employees.
AI checks receipts for required details like date, amount, merchant, and tax information.
Always-on checks to audit reports and apply your spend rules automatically, without slowing employees down.
Duplicates and other common issues are caught early, so approvers focus only on what truly needs review.
Simply attach your bill, then watch AI fill out accounting fields before routing it for approval.
